tasks.description: Find RECENT appointments (within the last 12 months) to ONLY these roles in the target organisation: CEO and CFO. Include only externally announced appointments with a clear publication date and source. Ignore all other roles.

Find RECENT appointments (within the last 12 months) to geographic leadership roles in the target organisation: Regional Head or Country Head. Exclude executives, Chief Officers, and subsidiary leadership.
Find RECENT appointments (within the last 12 months) to Chief Officer roles in the target organisation: CIO and CISO. Exclude CEO, CFO, regional roles, and subsidiary roles.
